asset.description: Which coin to classify on. Only BTCUSDT has 1d/1h data today.

loss_fn.description: Training loss. bcelogits = binary cross-entropy on logits (the classifier default).

learning_rate.description: Optimizer step size. ~0.0001 is the tuned default.

episodes.description: Training passes over the data. 1 episode underfit badly (degenerate all-negative); ~10 learns well.

buyreward_maxwait.description: How many bars ahead a profitable buy must occur for a sample to count as a positive ('dip').

buyreward_percent.description: The profit threshold (fraction) that counts as a profitable buy — sets how rare positives are.

pos_weight.description: Class weight for the positive (dip) class in the loss. 0 = auto-balance from class frequencies; 1 = none; >1 up-weights dips.

decision_threshold.description: Probability cutoff for predicting a dip (default 0.5). Lower catches more dips (higher recall, lower precision).

net_arch.description: Hidden-layer sizes of the MLP classifier.

device.description: Compute device: cpu, mps (Apple GPU), or cuda (NVIDIA GPU).

seed.description: Random seed. Same seed reproduces a run exactly; different seeds measure variance.
